jobs.title: Ergotherapeutin / Ergotherapeut
jobs.description:
Freue dich auf ein spannendes Aufgabengebiet, in welchem du im tagesklinischen und stationären Bereich tätig sein wirst. In einer angenehmen Arbeitsatmosphäre erwartet dich ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld, in dem du deine Fachkompetenz einbringen und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Psychiatrie St.Gallen mitgestalten kannst. Deine Aufgaben
• Gemeinsam mit unserem interdisziplinären Behandlungsteam betreust du Patientinnen und Patienten mit subakuten psychischen und sozialen Problemlagen im tagesklinischen Setting und wirkst aktiv an deren individueller Behandlung mit.
• Nach einer fundierten Einarbeitung leitest du ergotherapeutische Gruppentherapien im tagesklinischen Setting und begleitest die Patientinnen und Patienten strukturiert durch den gesamten Therapieprozess.
• Im stationären akutpsychiatrischen Setting übernimmst du im gerontopsychiatrischen Bereich ergotherapeutische Behandlungen in unterschiedlichen Einzel- und Gruppentherapien und bringst deine Fachkompetenz gezielt in die Behandlung ein.
• Als Teil eines engagierten interdisziplinären Behandlungsteams begleitest du Patientinnen und Patienten mit psychiatrischen Erkrankungen und verwandten gesundheitlichen Problemen und unterstützt sie gezielt bei ihrer sozialen und beruflichen Reintegration.
• Dein vielseitiger Arbeitsalltag umfasst das gesamte Spektrum psychiatrischer Krankheitsbilder und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine ergotherapeutische Expertise in unterschiedlichen Behandlungskontexten einzusetzen und dich eng mit anderen Abteilungen sowie zuweisenden Stellen abzustimmen. Dein Profil
• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Ergotherapeutin oder Ergotherapeut HF/FH und besitzt eine Berufsausübungsbewilligung des Kantons St.Gallen oder erfüllst die Voraussetzungen, diese vor Stellenantritt zu erlangen.
• Idealerweise bringst du Berufserfahrung in der Erwachsenen- und/oder Gerontopsychiatrie sowie Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Gruppentherapien mit und hast Freude an einem vielseitigen Aufgabengebiet und am wertschätzenden Umgang mit Patientinnen und Patienten.
• Interesse an der Durchführung von ZEPS-Gruppen (Zugehörigkeit Erleben, Perspektiven Schaffen) mit Fokus auf soziale Teilhabe und Alltagsaktivitäten ist von Vorteil.
• Kreativität, Innovationsfreude und gestalterisches Geschick sowie die Motivation, Therapieangebote und Behandlungspfade aktiv weiterzuentwickeln, zeichnen deine Arbeitsweise aus. Zudem erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihr künftiges Team kennenzulernen. Mündliche Zusage Sie erhalten von uns eine telefonische Zusage, wenn wir uns nach dem zweiten Gespräch für Sie entscheiden und fragen bei Ihnen nach, ob auch Sie weiterhin von uns überzeugt sind. descriptionByLocale.it:
Attendere con ansia un'emozionante area di lavoro in cui lavorerete nell'area clinica e ospedaliera quotidiana. In una piacevole atmosfera di lavoro, un ambiente vario vi aspetta, in cui potete contribuire alla vostra esperienza e contribuire a plasmare il futuro della psichiatria a St.Gallen insieme a noi. I tuoi compiti
• Insieme al nostro team di trattamento interdisciplinare, supporterai i pazienti con problemi psicologici e sociali subacuti nell'impostazione clinica quotidiana e contribuirai attivamente al loro trattamento individuale.
• Dopo una formazione approfondita, guiderai terapie di gruppo ergotherapeutic nell'impostazione clinica quotidiana e accompagnerai i pazienti in modo strutturato attraverso l'intero processo di terapia.
• Nell'ambiente psichiatrico acuto apatiente, si assumono trattamenti ergotherapeutic in varie terapie individuali e di gruppo nell'area gerontopsichiatrica e portare la vostra esperienza specificamente nel trattamento.
• Come parte di un team di trattamento interdisciplinare dedicato, accompagni pazienti con malattie psichiatriche e problemi di salute correlati e li sostenga nella loro reintegrazione sociale e professionale.
• Il vostro versatile lavoro quotidiano copre l'intero spettro di malattie psichiatriche e vi offre l'opportunità di utilizzare la vostra esperienza ergotherapeutica in diversi contesti di trattamento e di coordinare strettamente con altri dipartimenti e incarichi. Il tuo profilo
• Hai completato la formazione come terapista professionale HF/FH e hai un permesso di formazione professionale dal Canton St.Gallen o soddisfare le esigenze per ottenerla prima di assumere il lavoro.
• Idealmente, si avrà esperienza professionale in psichiatria adulta e/o gerontop, così come l'esperienza nella realizzazione di terapie di gruppo e godere di un campo versatile di lavoro e trattamento apprezzativo dei pazienti.
• L'interesse per l'attuazione dei gruppi ZEPS (esperienza, creazione di prospettive) con un focus sulla partecipazione sociale e le attività quotidiane è vantaggioso.
• Creatività, innovazione e competenze di design, nonché la motivazione per sviluppare attivamente offerte di terapia e percorsi di trattamento caratterizzano il vostro metodo di lavoro. Con circa 1.400 dipendenti, forniamo un trattamento psichiatrico accessibile, personale ed efficace e la cura per gli adulti nei cantoni di St.Gallen e Appenzell Ausserrhoden così come nel Principato del Liechtenstein nelle nostre nove sedi aziendali. Siamo sulla strada digitalmente e siamo impegnati alla sostenibilità, quindi non vediamo l'ora della vostra applicazione online tramite la nostra homepage. Non appena la vostra domanda è stata ricevuta da noi online, riceverete una conferma della ricevuta via e-mail. Siamo lieti di conoscervi sulla base del vostro dossier e verificare se le vostre qualifiche, competenze e voi come persona si adattano alla posizione pubblicizzata e la psichiatria St.Gallen. Allora ti contatteremo. Durante un'intervista personale ci conosceremo e imparerete di più sulla psichiatria St.Gallen, la posizione pubblicizzata e le sfide. Nel secondo round vorremmo ottenere un'immagine ancora migliore di voi e scoprire insieme a voi se ci adattiamo insieme. Hai anche l'opportunità di conoscere la tua squadra futura. Riceverete una conferma telefonica da noi se decidiamo per voi dopo la seconda intervista e vi chiediamo se siete ancora convinti di noi. Se siamo d'accordo, prepareremo il tuo contratto. Nei giorni seguenti ti invieremo il contratto per posta in doppio. Il contratto ti fornisce anche informazioni rilevanti sul tuo lavoro. Tra l'accettazione del lavoro e il primo giorno lavorativo, l'utente come nuovo dipendente può già accedere a informazioni interne rilevanti. Così si può ottenere un quadro differenziato della società e già prepararsi per il lavoro. Il primo giorno ci si può aspettare un onboarding nel vostro nuovo team e con altri colleghi. È impostato sul nuovo posto di lavoro e ottenere una panoramica delle vostre prossime attività. Ricevete anche il vostro piano di introduzione individuale, che vi aiuta a trovare la vostra strada intorno rapidamente.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Look forward to an exciting area of work in which you will work in the day-to-day clinical and inpatient area. In a pleasant working atmosphere, a varied environment awaits you, in which you can contribute your expertise and help shape the future of psychiatry in St.Gallen together with us. Your tasks
• Together with our interdisciplinary treatment team, you will support patients with subacute psychological and social problems in the daily clinical setting and actively contribute to their individual treatment.
• After in-depth training, you will lead ergotherapeutic group therapies in the daily clinical setting and accompany the patients in a structured way through the entire therapy process.
• In the inpatient acute psychiatric setting, you take over ergotherapeutic treatments in various individual and group therapies in the gerontopsychiatric area and bring your expertise specifically into the treatment.
• As part of a dedicated interdisciplinary treatment team, you accompany patients with psychiatric diseases and related health problems and support them in their social and professional reintegration.
• Your versatile day-to-day work covers the entire spectrum of psychiatric diseases and offers you the opportunity to use your ergotherapeutic expertise in different treatment contexts and to coordinate closely with other departments and assignments. Your profile
• You have completed training as an occupational therapist HF/FH and have a professional training permit from the Canton of St.Gallen or meet the requirements to obtain it before taking up the job.
• Ideally, you will have professional experience in adult and/or gerontop psychiatry as well as experience in carrying out group therapies and enjoy a versatile field of work and appreciative treatment of patients.
• Interest in the implementation of ZEPS groups (experience, perspective creation) with a focus on social participation and everyday activities is beneficial.
• Creativity, innovation and design skills as well as the motivation to actively develop therapy offers and treatment pathways characterize your work method. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. In the second round we would like to get an even better picture of you and find out together with you whether we fit together. You also get the opportunity to get to know your future team. You will receive a telephone confirmation from us if we decide for you after the second interview and ask you if you are still convinced of us. If we agree, we will draw up your contract. In the following days we will send you the contract by post in double. The contract also provides you with relevant information about your employment. Between the acceptance of the job and the first working day, you as a new employee can already access relevant internal information. So you can get a differentiated picture of the company and already prepare for the job. On the first day you can expect an onboarding in your new team and with other colleagues. You set up at the new workplace and get an overview of your next tasks. You also receive your individual introduction plan, which helps you to find your way around quickly.

Tasks:
• Together with our interdisciplinary treatment team, you will support patients with subacute psychological and social problems in the daily clinical setting and actively contribute to their individual treatment.
• After in-depth training, you will lead ergotherapeutic group therapies in the daily clinical setting and accompany the patients in a structured way through the entire therapy process.
• In the inpatient acute psychiatric setting, you take over ergotherapeutic treatments in various individual and group therapies in the gerontopsychiatric area and bring your expertise specifically into the treatment.
• As part of a dedicated interdisciplinary treatment team, you accompany patients with psychiatric diseases and related health problems and support them in their social and professional reintegration.
• Your versatile day-to-day work covers the entire spectrum of psychiatric diseases and offers you the opportunity to use your ergotherapeutic expertise in different treatment contexts and to coordinate closely with other departments and assignments.

Requirements
• You have completed training as an occupational therapist HF/FH and have a professional training permit from the Canton of St.Gallen or meet the requirements to obtain it before taking up the job.
• Ideally, you will have professional experience in adult and/or gerontop psychiatry as well as experience in carrying out group therapies and enjoy a versatile field of work and appreciative treatment of patients.
• Interest in the implementation of ZEPS groups (experience, perspective creation) with a focus on social participation and everyday activities is beneficial.
• Creativity, innovation and design skills as well as the motivation to actively develop therapy offers and treatment pathways characterize your work method.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Réjouissez-vous d'un domaine de travail passionnant dans lequel vous travaillerez dans le domaine clinique et hospitalier quotidien. Dans une ambiance de travail agréable, un environnement varié vous attend, dans lequel vous pouvez apporter votre expertise et aider à façonner l'avenir de la psychiatrie à Saint-Gall avec nous. Vos tâches
• Avec notre équipe de traitement interdisciplinaire, vous accompagnerez les patients souffrant de problèmes psychologiques et sociaux subaigus dans le cadre clinique quotidien et contribuerez activement à leur traitement individuel.
• Après une formation approfondie, vous dirigerez les thérapies de groupe ergothérapeutiques dans le cadre clinique quotidien et accompagnerez les patients de manière structurée tout au long du processus thérapeutique.
• Dans le cadre psychiatrique aigu du patient, vous prenez en charge des traitements ergothérapeutiques dans diverses thérapies individuelles et de groupe dans le domaine gérontopsychiatrique et apportez votre expertise spécifiquement dans le traitement.

Your tasks
• With your professional competence, you strengthen our team of reception and emergency station 60+ in the field of gerontopsychiatry and actively participate in the day-to-day work of the station.
• As a caregiver, you assume the nursing responsibility for the individual care and care of our patients and accompany them safely through the nursing and therapeutic process.
• Even in complex situations, you can negotiate safely, carry out medical and technical prescriptions and perform administrative tasks as well as carefully documenting and reporting your observations.
• An important focus of your work is the support and support of our HF students, whose learning process you specifically promote and support with planned learning support in a practical manner.
• You ensure the training assignment in everyday station life and carry out location interviews, learning interviews and qualification interviews.
• In exchange with the training managers, you contribute to a reliable training quality and, in the absence of the responsible vocational training managers, also take over the support of our FaGe learners. Your profile
• You will also bring a completed training as a nurse HF or FH as well as the required SRK recognition or a positive SRK PreCheck at a foreign diploma.
• Ideally, you have already gained experience in the psychiatric field and work with pleasure with mentally ill people as well as in a multi-professional team.
• With your social skills, your flexibility and resilience, you convince as well as with an independent, self-responsible and committed way of working.
• Very good knowledge of German at at least C1 level and good IT skills are part of your profile and support you in your administrative tasks.
• For the accompaniment of our HF students, you bring professional competence in care, supervision and medical technology and have the course SVEB 1 or are ready to complete it with generous support from us. With around 1,400 employees, we provide accessible, personal and effective psychiatric treatment and care for adults in the cantons of St.Gallen and Appenzell Ausserrhoden as well as in the Principality of Liechtenstein at our nine company locations. We are on the road digitally and are committed to sustainability, so we look forward to your online application via our homepage. As soon as your application has been received by us online, you will receive a confirmation of receipt by e-mail. We are happy to get to know you based on your dossier and check whether your qualifications, skills and you as a person fit the advertised position and the psychiatry St.Gallen. Then we will contact you. During a personal interview we get to know each other and you will learn more about the psychiatry St.Gallen, the advertised position and the challenges. • Im tagesklinischen Setting übernimmst du die psychiatrisch-psychotherapeutische und psychoedukative Behandlung von Alterspatientinnen und Alterspatienten ab 60 Jahren im Gruppensetting und führst Vorgespräche zur Indikationsstellung für das tagesklinische Programm.

• Nell'impostazione clinica quotidiana, si prende il sopravvento del trattamento psichiatrico-psicoterapeutico e psicoeducativo di pazienti di età superiore ai 60 anni nell'impostazione di gruppo e condurre discussioni preliminari sull'indicazione per il programma clinico quotidiano.

• Controllo esterno regolare, discussioni di casi interni e supporto professionale individuale da parte di una gestione psicoterapeutica e psichiatrica esperta vi accompagnano nel vostro sviluppo professionale.
